requirement.summary: TMS 2.0-In the online mode, Search Member is unable to obtain the Membership No.
requirement.description:
Steps To Reproduce:

Test in (trunk env) https://test-multi-hq.hero-cloud.cn/accounts/hqqccn7/admin/eng/home       (both hqqccn5)

1.Login Backend>Table Management System>Other Settings > Config by Loaction:

Add configuration (The specific configuration can be found in the attachment.):

1.Online Reservation using Member Verification

2.Auto Member Profile Matching

2. Add the "Search Member" button field to the online theme.

3. Open the online reservation page. Enter the reservation information，

4. Click the "Search Member" button，Enter "Member No." and "Mobile No.".

5. Click "Confirm" button

Expect result:

Membership No. shows the corresponding value.

Actual result:

Display is empty。
